summary: Round 5 recheck (03:20-03:55 UTC 26 Sep). It picks three closed ideas that rounds 1-4 did not cover. Already covered and skipped: floatout, I-077/78, tempfuse, swapfix, clip-boundary, axis-flip, head-shift scale, refined-dup collapse, leaf prune, RE-AIM/pair-GBM/BYTE, the runtime-rejected ideas, DNVETO/DivNet veto, ANTIPAR, finals EMAX/twin. The linefit arc already ran in exp60. Two of the three were measured on CPU on the exp60 x138 lab (56 clips, official metric, raw np.array_equal freezes). (A) Frozen-frame / post-freeze transitions (v2 frozen-frame-double-step, dropped). The old premise was that the defect was 'worth nothing once the edge filter runs'. That premise is gone: x138 has no edge filter, and its flow-prior relink did NOT fix the defect. On 30 of 39 6bba lab clips (0 of 17 44b6), post-freeze transitions have FN 10.3% vs 4.5% and FP/TP 13.1% vs 4.8%. The lab ceiling is about +0.006. The excess is link-class on genuinely ~2x steps (both_linked/one_free FN, GT step median ~7 um). NEW FACT, but it STAYS CLOSED for the finals. The only fixes ever measured (velocity carry, sqrt(k+1) gates) were ~0 or net negative. ILP-first is the failed in-sample channel. The exp60 dumps have no pre-relink hook, so there is no CPU replay. R8 ends new mechanisms at 27 Sep 12:00. If the public embryo has no freezes, R4 cannot read the change. This is post-deadline item #1 for the linker. (B) B27(a) 'already-divided' fork filter (probe 18 bundle, 0.946) is CLOSED by measurement on x138: -0.0007 on control and -0.0006 on ins35. It drops 1 TP fork and 3 TP edges for -2 FP forks. 'GT-safe by construction' is false on predicted ancestry. (C) AdaBN, which passed the honest B5 LOEO at +0.0073 but lost -0.0066 on the public stack, STAYS CLOSED under the public/private split and the headroom. Runtime was never the blocker. It would move the 224-d features the x138 V1284 head and DaughterNet read, it inflated raw nodes 1.1-2x in-sample, the public embryo shows no large shift for the pilkwang stack, and it is a detection-map change (0/5 on the LB) with no honest lab under R8/R9. No plan change, no build, no probe.

findings.what: Frozen-frame double step / 'ILP-first on post-freeze transitions' (wf_ideas_v2 frozen-frame-double-step; v2 Dropped table). OLD VERDICT (24 Sep, exp39 + edge filter): the geometric part (velocity carry, sqrt(k+1) gates) measured ~0 after the edge filter, and the gates were net negative before it (+31 TP / +58 FP). The remaining ILP-first part gained only by trusting the in-sample edge net, the channel that gave 0 / -0.001 / -0.002 on the LB (probes 21/29/30). Ceiling after ef: +0.004 pooled on 199 videos. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The base is x138. It has no edge filter, so the old 'worth nothing once ef runs' premise is gone. Its flow-prior relink (seed tight 5.5 um, flow tight 7 um) could have absorbed the doubled post-freeze motion. (2) The exp60 x138 lab exists. (3) Public = one embryo, private = 71% other embryos. Freezes belong to a recording's acquisition clock: 6bba has them, 44b6 has none. So a freeze fix is invisible on a freeze-free public embryo and matters only on private. MEASURED NOW (exp60, 56 clips, raw np.array_equal on the train zarr). 30 of 39 6bba clips and 0 of 17 44b6 clips have freezes (248 frozen transitions). x138 GT-edge rates by source-frame class: normal FN 3.85% (4.53% inside freeze clips), FP/TP 4.0% (4.83%); frozen FN 3.6%, FP/TP 2.1%; POST-FREEZE (2,066 GT edges) FN 10.3%, FP/TP 13.1%; post+1 FN 5.5%, FP/TP 5.4%. Excess on post transitions is ~120 FN + ~152 FP. Removing all of it is worth about +0.0063 pooled lab (+0.0068 per 6bba GT), larger than the old base's +0.004. So the flow prior did NOT fix it. Post FN anatomy: both_linked 86 (GT step median 7.05 um, 45% > 7 um), one_free 49 (6.74 um, 51% > 7 um), miss 72, against normal frames' 1.5% / 0.75% / 2.3% at ~3 um steps. These are link errors on genuinely ~2x steps, unlike the normal-frame both_linked FN, which round 3 showed are localisation. NEW VERDICT: NEW FACT, but STAYS CLOSED for 29 Sep. (a) No fix class has transfer evidence: velocity carry measured ~0, sqrt(k+1) gate scaling was net FP-positive on exp39, and ILP-first is the in-sample edge-net channel. (b) The exp60 dumps hold only presafe/preshort/final/dc, so a change inside motion_relink_edges cannot be replayed on CPU. It needs a new GPU lab with a pre-relink hook plus a patch, dummy and slot before R8 (27 Sep 12:00). (c) On a freeze-free public embryo the change is byte-identical, so R4 (+0.002 public for edge/fork-set changers) can never adopt it, and section f/f2 admits no unmeasured private-only rider. (d) Private value: capture 0-30% of the ceiling x P(private embryo has freezes ~0.5) = ~0..+0.001, with an unknown sign. It stays the largest single post-deadline linker target found so far.

findings.what: B27(a) 'already divided' fork filter: a fork whose ancestor already forked in the clip keeps only its nearest child. OLD VERDICT (15-16 Sep, exp29 base): probe 18 bundled (a) with a 5 um sister floor and scored 0.946 against 0.947. That was read as 'a tie inside noise, not adopted'. The part (a) alone was argued to be 'structurally safe: 0 of 151 GT divisions chain within a video, so it cannot remove a true one', with local FP 13 -> 11 and +0.0009. WHAT CHANGED: (1) x138 has no such filter. (2) The DaughterNet insertion (in K2) adds forks that could chain onto existing forks. (3) A 'GT-safe' removal is the kind of rider that gains most on private, where the break-even J is lower (0.11-0.20). (4) The noise premise is overturned, so probe 18's -0.001 on the bundle is a real public-embryo read. MEASURED NOW on exp60 (56 clips, official metric, rule applied in time order). Control: 676 forks, 26 chained, with fork labels TP 1 / FP 2 / ignored 23. Dropped edges: TP 3 / FP 0 / ignored 23. Division TP/FP 16/25 -> 15/23. Pooled score -0.00068 (44b6 SELECTION +0.00072, 6bba CONFIRMATION -0.00190). On ins35 (K2-like): 877 forks, 33 chained (4 of them inserted), pooled -0.00055. NEW VERDICT: CLOSED by measurement. 'GT-safe by construction' is false in practice. The rule keys on PREDICTED ancestry, so a spurious (FP or ignored) ancestor fork makes a true downstream division look chained. Dropping the farther child can also remove a TP edge (3 of 26 dropped edges were TP). It is a fork-set changer with a negative lab sign, and R4/R8 apply as well.

findings.what: B5 AdaBN (per-video, target-image-only BatchNorm recalibration with a node-count guard [0.90, 1.05]). OLD VERDICT (21 Sep): the honest LOEO gate PASSED (+0.00728 on the 6bba-only scratch model, 0.680 -> 0.688, guard applied on 9/12), but it was rejected for the public stack. exp38 regression on 12 in-sample 44b6 videos: raw -0.0437, guarded -0.0066 (guard accepted 4/12), with raw nodes inflated x1.1-2.0 on 8/12 videos. No LB probe. Round 3 only mentioned it in passing ('do not list AdaBN-style changes as private-leaning'). WHY IT COULD LOOK MISJUDGED: it is the only idea that ever passed an HONEST unseen-embryo gate. The exp38 rejection was measured on videos the public weights had seen, which is exactly the regime where AdaBN has nothing to fix. With private = 71% other embryos and ~4 h of runtime headroom, a test-time adaptation looks like the natural private-leaning lever. RE-READ: (1) Runtime was never the blocker (adaptation ~78 s per 12 videos, ~11 min per 100 clips), so the headroom revives nothing. (2) The x138-specific blocker is new and decisive. The V1284 head, which carries x138's +0.007, gathers 224-d detector features and was trained on the unadapted pilkwang features. The DaughterNet insertion and the readmit/lowdet pools also read detector outputs. AdaBN shifts all of them off-distribution at once, so the honest B5 number (scratch model, no head) does not transfer to x138. (3) The regime argument cuts against it. B5 gained where the model had a huge embryo shift (own-train 0.833 vs LOEO 0.680). The pilkwang stack on the public embryo scores 0.953, above its own in-sample lab (exp60 control 44b6 0.911 / 6bba 0.936; different clip mix, weak evidence), so there is no sign of a large shift to correct. Meanwhile the in-sample regression shows the adaptation's own cost (node inflation, guard fallback). (4) It is a detection-map change: 0 of 5 on our LB (Z-flip -0.009, axis-flip -0.001, secondary swaps). exp60 is in-sample for the detector, so there is no honest x138 lab. R4 needs +0.002 public, R8 ends new mechanisms at 27 Sep 12:00, and R9's no-retraining rule covers weight/statistics adaptation in spirit. Its variance also works against P(private F1 > x138). NEW VERDICT: STAYS CLOSED, with a sharper reason. The honest gate pass was real but belongs to a model without the x138 head, and the public/private split does not create a measurable path by 29 Sep.
